full_dataset_size: Repo itself ~14 KB source, no data. Full ABNB Form 4 history: ~491 filings since May 2023 in the recent submissions JSON plus the older shard CIK0001559720-submissions-001.json (452 filings 2012-10-24 to 2023-04-29, most Form 4s post-IPO Dec 2020); each Form 4 XML is ~3-10 KB, so the complete ABNB insider panel is roughly 700-900 XML files, under 10 MB, pullable keyless at 10 req/s with a UA header.
description: A small MIT-licensed Python library that parses SEC Form 4 (insider transaction) XML into typed objects (issuer, reporters, non-derivative and derivative transactions with code, shares, price, post-transaction holdings) and ships an optional rate-limited EDGAR fetcher and CLI; the repo holds code and two fixture filings only, no data. The sample pairs it with a keyless pull of Airbnb's EDGAR submissions index (CIK 1559720) filtered to Form 4/4A, one live ABNB Form 4 XML, and the parser's output over it, confirming the parser works on a current filing. Grain is one row per transaction per filing, sourced from data.sec.gov / sec.gov Archives. An analyst would loop the index to fetch every ABNB Form 4 and build an insider buy/sell and 10b5-1 sale panel alongside the guidance ledger for context around the 5 Nov print; it is not a KPI input.
issues: None blocking. Parser exports parse() not parse_form4() (job card guess). Repo has 0 stars and a single push (2026-04-17), so maintenance is uncertain; EDGAR Form 4 XML schema is stable, so low risk. The older submissions shard was not pulled (kept to one index fetch + one filing). SEC requires a declared User-Agent; no key or login.
